senses.gloss: m.(b. h.;עָצַבform, esp. idol.—Pl. עֲצַבִּים. Sifra K’dosh., beg. ע׳ על שם שנעשו פרקים פרקים idols are called ‘forms’, because they are made limb by limb; Mekh. Mishp. s. 20; Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXIV.—
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 63b:14">Snh. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>ועושין דמות עֲצַבֵּיהֶם</he> (not <he>עצבים</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1) they made an image of their (the rich men’s) figures; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 529:4">Yalk. Hos. 529</cite>.
